events.title: L.A. Zoo Lights
events.organizer: Los Angeles Zoo and Botanical Gardens
events.ageLabel: All ages. Children under 2 are free
events.schedule: Select nights Nov 20 to Jan 10, 6 to 10pm
events.priceLabel: Adults $29 to $35, kids 2 to 12 $19 to $25, under 2 free

registration.note: Tickets are on sale now on the zoo's website, with two entry times each night. Booking ahead online is recommended. The box office also sells tickets on event nights while they last.

events.description: Glowing paths and light displays fill the zoo after dark, plus a new outdoor skating rink. A sensory-inclusive night with no flash photography runs Dec 8.
events.sourceNote: Run dates Nov 20 to Jan 10, 6-10pm hours, closed dates (Nov 26, 30, Dec 1, 7, 14-16, 24, 25, 31, Jan 4-7), Dec 8 Sensory-Inclusive night and Dec 17 Pride Night confirmed on lazoo.org Zoo Lights 2026 page and Events page. Tiered prices (Value Weekday $29/$19, Value Weekend $32/$22, Holiday Peak $35/$25 non-member adult/child 2-12, members $5 less), under-2 free, two timed entry times, re-entry only Dec 8, and stroller rules from the Zoo Lights FAQ. Sessions are the first 12 open nights taken from the FAQ's price-tier date lists. Skating rink needs a separate ticket. Original on-sale date not stated.

events.title: Enchanted Forest of Light
events.address: 1418 Descanso Drive, La Cañada Flintridge, CA 91011
events.ageLabel: All ages. Children 2 and under are free
events.schedule: Nightly Nov 22 to Jan 9, 5:30 to 10pm (closed Nov 26 and Dec 25)
events.priceLabel: Adults $29 to $52, kids $19 to $37, ages 2 and under free

registration.note: Buy tickets online or call 818-949-4200. Prices change by date and entry time. Popular nights sell out, so book ahead.

events.description: A glowing walk-through light show winds through the gardens after dark. The route is stroller friendly.
events.sourceNote: Run Nov 22, 2026 to Jan 9, 2027, 5:30-10pm, closed Nov 26 and Dec 25, prices (non-member adult $29-52, child $19-37; member adult $22-45, child $12-30; Anytime Tickets $65/$85), 'Children ages 2 and under are free', sell-out warning and stroller access from the Enchanted FAQ page. Run dates and $12-$52 range also on the Nov 25 event page. Nov 22-28 nightly listings (no Nov 26) seen on the Kids & Families events list. Sessions are the first 12 open nights. Child age band not stated. Member presale was in July; general on-sale date not stated.

events.title: Little Explorers
events.address: 1418 Descanso Drive, La Cañada Flintridge, CA 91011
events.schedule: Fri Nov 13 and Sat Nov 14, 9:30 to 11:30am
events.priceLabel: Included with garden admission. Free for members

registration.note: Included with a garden visit. Non-members need a general admission ticket, and members get in free.

events.description: Arts, crafts and nature exploration for little kids out in the gardens. A new session comes around each month.
events.sourceNote: Dates, 9:30-11:30am times, 'Families with young children (aged 2-5 years old)... each month', and 'Included with admission or membership' from the Descanso Kids & Families events list. Registration requirement not stated on the listing, so treated as drop-in. Admission price not given on the pages fetched.

events.title: Little Bookworms
events.address: 1418 Descanso Drive, La Cañada Flintridge, CA 91011
events.priceLabel: Included with garden admission. Free for members

registration.note: No registration needed. Meet at Magnolia Court. Non-members need a garden admission ticket.

events.description: A short outdoor story time in the gardens for little listeners and their grown-ups.
events.sourceNote: Date, 10-10:30am, ages 2-7 with caregiver, Magnolia Court meeting spot, included with admission or membership, and no registration required, all from the Descanso Kids & Families events list.

events.title: Baby/Toddler Storytime
events.ageLabel: Made for ages 0 to 18 months. All are welcome

registration.note: Free. Head to the branch Community Room a few minutes before 10:30.

events.description: Singing, talking and play build early language skills. Each week brings new books, puppets, bubbles and familiar tunes babies can follow.
events.sourceNote: All 12 dates, 10:30-11am times, Community Room, address and 'designed especially for children ages 0 to 18 months, but all are welcome' from the LAPL event page, which lists dates 11/4/2026 to 2/24/2027 and skips 11/11 (Veterans Day closure), 11/25 and 12/30. The 11/4 session was left out as same-day. Registration requirement not stated on the page, treated as drop-in.

events.title: Baby and Toddler Storytime
events.ageLabel: Babies and toddlers with a grown-up

registration.note: Free. Come to the branch on Monday morning in time for the 10:30 start.

events.description: Stories, songs and fingerplays to start the week. An easy first library outing for babies and toddlers.
events.sourceNote: Weekly Monday 10:30am dates 11/9/2026 to 12/28/2026, branch address and 'stories, songs, and fingerplays' description from the LAPL event page. Audience tag is 'Babies and Toddlers' with no stated range, so ageMaxMonths 35 is an approximation. End time and registration requirement not stated, treated as drop-in.

events.title: Toddler Storytime and Songs
events.venue: West Los Angeles Regional Branch Library
events.address: 11360 Santa Monica Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA 90025

registration.note: Free. Arrive a little before 10am to settle in.

events.description: Stories, songs and movement for busy toddlers. Each session builds early reading skills through play.
events.sourceNote: Weekly Wednesday 10-10:45am dates through 1/13/2027 (no 11/11 session), ages 18 months to 3 years, branch address from the LAPL event page. The 11/4 session was left out as same-day. Registration requirement not stated on the page, treated as drop-in. Page lists the branch as 'West Los Angeles'.

events.title: Baby & Toddler Storytime
events.address: 861 Alma Real Drive, Pacific Palisades, CA 90272
events.ageLabel: Up to 36 months, one lap per child

registration.note: Free. Bring one grown-up lap for each child and meet in the Green Bungalow.

events.description: A cozy lap-sit story time where babies, toddlers and their grown-ups share books together.
events.sourceNote: Monthly first-Wednesday 10:30am series, Green Bungalow location, 'babies and toddlers up to 36 months' and 'each child needs their own lap' from the LAPL event page, which lists 11/4/2026 and 12/2/2026 only. Only 12/2 included. End time and registration requirement not stated, treated as drop-in.

events.title: Toddler Tuesday
events.ageLabel: Geared to toddlers. The museum is open to all ages
events.priceLabel: Included with museum admission. Free for members

registration.note: Toddler Tuesday comes with general admission, and members get in free. Museum tickets are sold on the Kidspace website.

events.description: Play spaces are adapted for little ones on these school-day mornings. Winter Frolic adds sock skating and a winter trike ride through Jan 10.
events.sourceNote: Dates Nov 10, 17, Dec 1, 8, 15 at 10am-12pm from the Kidspace toddler calendar and events list. 'Included with Admission' and 'free for members', play spaces adapted for 'littles', no Tuesdays during school breaks, from a Toddler Tuesday event page. Winter Frolic Nov 6, 2026 to Jan 10, 2027 from the events list, activities from the Winter Frolic page (sock skating is a separate $6 ticket). Admission price and age range not stated, so ageMaxMonths 47 is an approximation.

events.title: Toddler Sing-Along
events.address: 2701 N. Sepulveda Boulevard, Los Angeles, CA 90049
events.ageLabel: Babies, toddlers and young children with caregivers

registration.note: Comes with general admission to Noah's Ark at the Skirball. Reserving a 90-minute Noah's Ark time slot ahead is recommended.

events.description: Skirball educators lead circle time aboard Noah's Ark. Families learn songs and lap games as they sing, move and play together.
events.sourceNote: Weekly 'Wednesdays, 3:15 pm', 'Caregivers, babies, and young children', included with Noah's Ark admission, 'Reservations recommended' and 90-minute time slots from the Skirball program page. The page gives no specific dates, so sessions are the next six Wednesdays derived from the weekly schedule. Holiday closures, program length and admission price not stated. ageMaxMonths 47 is an approximation. Site banner says the main phone line is out of service.

events.title: Big Fish Little Fish: Penguins
events.priceLabel: $110.90 per adult and child pair, $30 for members

registration.note: Book and pay ahead on the event page. Cancel at least 72 hours before for a full refund. A shark-themed class follows in January.

events.description: Kids and grown-ups touch animals in a private classroom, tour the California Terrace and play hands-on games. Aquarium admission is included.
events.sourceNote: Nov 14, 2026 9-10:30am Penguins session with California Terrace tour, ages 3-6 with an adult, $110.90 per pair ($30 member pair, member guests $50.95 adult / $38.95 child), admission included, pre-registration and pre-payment required, 72-hour refund rule, and January Sharks theme (no date given) from the aquarium's Big Fish Little Fish page.
